sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B (batch) - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
sources.snippet: As a native vision-language model, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B demonstrates outstanding results across a full range of benchmark evaluations, including reasoning, coding, agent capabilities, and multimodal understanding, empowering developers and enterprises to achieve significantly greater productivity.
